purpose: Step 1 of research/experiment-design-proposal-2026-10.md: the controlled reproduction of the Greedy result. Step 1 runs exactly this and changes nothing.

control120.why: Run 1's recipe trained to generation 120. gen60 vs control120 isolates the extra training; control120 vs gen120 isolates the ownership head.

opponents.reference_evaluator_for_step_2_only: edax-l5 and above, Edax 4.6, opening book off, one thread

search.why: Every historical number (Run 1 crossgen, the 1000-game matches) was measured at 50. Budget sensitivity (64 / 256 / 800) is a Step 2 question on selected positions.

command: reversi arena --suite custom -e random -e greedy -e minimax-d4 -e gen60=models/reversi-8x8-gen60.pt -e control120=models/reversi-8x8-control-gen120.pt -e gen120=models/reversi-8x8-gen120.pt --games 200 --simulations 50 --opening-plies 4 --seed 20261025 --workers 6 --record-games --out runs/research/pilot-2026-10.json --notes "Step 1 pilot, research/eval-protocol-frozen.json"
analysis_rules: Score = (wins + 0.5 * draws) / games, with a Wilson 95% interval per pairing and a bootstrap interval per rating, as the report already computes.
Report every pairing split by colour.
Opening pairs are the unit of resampling for any uncertainty on a colour difference: the two games of a pair share a position and are not independent.
Count wipeouts (one side ends with zero discs) per pairing and per colour; it is a predefined descriptor, not a post-hoc one.

The three checkpoints are read as two comparisons, each changing one thing: gen60 to control120 (same recipe, 60 more generations) and control120 to gen120 (same generation, ownership head added). A difference between gen60 and gen120 alone is not attributed to either.
